en-US.title: [Desk] Democratic Party Nominates Candidates for All Yeongju Constituencies / Andong MBC
en-US.description:
2026/05/13 08:30:00 Author: Lee Do-eun

With the Democratic Party of Korea fielding candidates in all constituencies in Yeongju City ahead of the June 3 local elections, changes in the local political landscape are expected.

Following the confirmation of former Seoul City Council member Woo Chang-yoon as the candidate for Yeongju Mayor on the 7th, the Democratic Party nominated Jo Jung-yeol, former Chairman of the Bonghwa Police Station Workplace Council, for the 1st Provincial Assembly constituency, and Choi In-sik, former Yeongju City Council member, for the 2nd constituency.

For candidates for local council members, Kim Ki-hoon, former professor at Gyeongbuk College, was nominated for Constituency A; Choi Rak-sun, former Secretary-General of the Yeongju Citizens' Solidarity, for Constituency B; Choi Seon-hee, Chairwoman of the Democratic Party's Women's Committee, for Constituency C; Jang Young-hee, former City Council member, for Constituency D; Mok Seung-gyun, President of the Yeongju Bodybuilding Association, for Constituency E; and Jeon Young-tak, former City Council member, for Constituency F. Kim Myeong-jeong, Vice Director of Pharos Entrance Exam Academy, was nominated for proportional representation. #AndongMBC #AndongMBCNews #NewsDesk #NewsToday

id.title: [Meja] Partai Demokrat Menominasikan Calon untuk Semua Daerah Pemilihan Yeongju / Andong MBC
id.description:
13/05/2026 08:30:00 Penulis: Lee Do-eun

Dengan Partai Demokrat Korea mengajukan kandidat di semua daerah pemilihan di Kota Yeongju menjelang pemilihan lokal 3 Juni, perubahan dalam lanskap politik lokal diperkirakan akan terjadi.

Setelah konfirmasi mantan anggota Dewan Kota Seoul, Woo Chang-yoon, sebagai kandidat Walikota Yeongju pada tanggal 7, Partai Demokrat mencalonkan Jo Jung-yeol, mantan Ketua Dewan Tempat Kerja Kantor Polisi Bonghwa, untuk daerah pemilihan Majelis Provinsi ke-1, dan Choi In-sik, mantan anggota Dewan Kota Yeongju, untuk daerah pemilihan ke-2.

Untuk kandidat anggota dewan lokal, Kim Ki-hoon, mantan profesor di Gyeongbuk College, dinominasikan untuk Daerah Pemilihan A; Choi Rak-sun, mantan Sekretaris Jenderal Solidaritas Warga Yeongju, untuk Daerah Pemilihan B; Choi Seon-hee, Ketua Komite Wanita Partai Demokrat, untuk Daerah Pemilihan C; Jang Young-hee, mantan anggota Dewan Kota, untuk Daerah Pemilihan D; Mok Seung-gyun, Presiden Asosiasi Binaraga Yeongju, untuk Daerah Pemilihan E; dan Jeon Young-tak, mantan anggota Dewan Kota, untuk Daerah Pemilihan F. Kim Myeong-jeong, Wakil Direktur Akademi Ujian Masuk Pharos, dinominasikan untuk perwakilan proporsional. #AndongMBC #AndongMBCNews #NewsDesk #NewsToday

snippet.title: [R]낙석에 뺏긴 목숨…'관리 소홀' 인재인가 / 안동MBC
snippet.description:
2026/05/13 08:30:00    작성자 : 양관희
 
◀ 앵 커 ▶
대구 남구 공원 인근 지하차도 비탈면에서
암석 등이 떨어져 한 명이 숨진 사고와 관련해 원인을 찾고, 책임을 물어야 한다는 목소리가 나오고 있습니다.

행정당국에 책임을 물을 수 있는지,
경찰 수사에 관심이 쏠리고 있습니다.

변예주 기자가 보도합니다.
◀ END ▶
◀ 리포트 ▶

대구 남구 낙석 사고 현장에서
전문가 등이 조사를 벌입니다.

지난 8일 낙석으로
사망사고가 발생한 곳입니다.

이곳을 점검한 전문가는 암반을 살펴본 결과, 암반이 깨지면서 생긴 절리 현상을 확인했고,
그 틈새에 나무가 뿌리를 내리고 있었다고
밝혔습니다.

당일 바람이 강하게 불어 나무가 흔들리면서
암반의 불연속면들이 벌어져 낙석 사고가
발생한 것으로 추정했습니다.

당시 대구에는 최대 순간풍속 초당 16m의
강풍이 불었습니다.

◀ INT ▶최정해 / 경북대학교 지구과학교육과 교수
"(나무가)강풍에 의해서 심하게 흔들리고
그 흔들림으로 인해서 아마 지금까지 견디고
있던 절리 면이 이완 되면서(낙석이 발생한
것 같습니다.)"

이번 낙석 사망사고 진상을 철저히 규명하고
행정당국에 책임을 물어야 한다는 목소리가
시민사회단체 등에서 나오는 상황.

경찰은 대구시와 남구청을 상대로 업무상
과실치사죄 여부 등을 살펴보고 있습니다.

우선 이 비탈면이 자연적으로 있던 것인지,
인위적으로 만들어진 건지가 관건입니다.

지하차도와 인도 등을 내면서 행정당국이
사면을 건드렸는지, 아니면 산 끝자락에 있는 자연 사면인지 확인해야 합니다.

사고 위험을 알 수 있었는지도 따져봐야 하는데 이곳을 지나다니는 주민들은 평소에
위험해 보였다고 말합니다.

사고 나기 전 도로 사진을 보면 나무들이
가파른 암석 사이에 뿌리를 내리고 자라있어
위태로워 보입니다.

◀ INT ▶낙석 사고 현장 인근 주민
"풍화 현상이 일어나고 물이 흘러 들어가고
하면 층석이니까 부서지는 자갈이잖아.
바윗덩어리가 아니고 단단하게. 그 전에는
위험해서 내(늘) 돌 굴러떨어졌다니까.
25년 살았어요."

대구시와 남구청은 사고가 난 사면이 법적
관리대상이 아니었다고 주장하고 있습니다.

인도를 걷다 날벼락 같은 낙석에 숨진 사고,
원인을 철저히 규명하고 책임을 물어야
반복되지 않을 수 있습니다.

MBC뉴스 변예주입니다.
(영상취재 윤종희)
#안동MBC #안동MBC뉴스 #뉴스데스크 #뉴스투데이

id.title: [R] Nyawa Hilang Akibat Longsoran Batu… Apakah Ini Bencana Buatan Manusia Akibat Kelalaian? / And...
id.description:
13/05/2026 08:30:00 Penulis: Yang Gwan-hee

◀ Penyiar ▶

Seruan sedang digaungkan untuk mengidentifikasi penyebab dan meminta pertanggungjawaban pihak yang bertanggung jawab atas kecelakaan yang menewaskan satu orang setelah bebatuan dan puing-puing jatuh dari lereng terowongan dekat taman di Nam-gu, Daegu.

Perhatian terfokus pada penyelidikan polisi untuk melihat apakah pihak berwenang dapat dimintai pertanggungjawaban.

Laporan oleh Byeon Ye-ju.

◀ SELESAI ▶

◀ Laporan ▶

Para ahli dan pihak lain sedang melakukan penyelidikan di lokasi kecelakaan longsoran batu di Nam-gu, Daegu.

Ini adalah lokasi di mana kecelakaan fatal terjadi akibat longsoran batu pada tanggal 8.

Seorang ahli yang memeriksa lokasi tersebut mengungkapkan bahwa setelah memeriksa batuan dasar, mereka mengkonfirmasi fenomena retakan yang disebabkan oleh pecahnya batuan, dan bahwa sebuah pohon telah berakar di celah-celah tersebut.

Diduga kecelakaan longsor terjadi karena angin kencang pada hari itu menyebabkan pohon bergoyang, memperlebar diskontinuitas pada batuan dasar.

Pada saat itu, angin kencang dengan kecepatan sesaat maksimum 16 meter per detik bertiup di Daegu.

◀ INT ▶ Choi Jeong-hae / Profesor, Departemen Pendidikan Ilmu Bumi, Universitas Nasional Kyungpook
"Tampaknya pohon-pohon tersebut bergoyang hebat akibat angin kencang, dan sebagai akibat dari goncangan tersebut, permukaan sambungan yang selama ini menahan beban menjadi longgar (menyebabkan longsor)."

Kelompok masyarakat sipil dan lainnya menyerukan penyelidikan menyeluruh terhadap kebenaran di balik kecelakaan longsor yang fatal ini dan agar pihak berwenang bertanggung jawab.

Polisi sedang menyelidiki apakah Kota Daegu dan Kantor Nam-gu bersalah atas pembunuhan karena kelalaian.

Yang terpenting, masalah kuncinya adalah apakah lereng ini ada secara alami atau dibuat secara buatan.

Harus dipastikan apakah pihak berwenang telah memanipulasi lereng tersebut saat membangun terowongan dan trotoar, atau apakah itu lereng alami yang terletak di tepi gunung.

Perlu juga diperiksa apakah risiko kecelakaan dapat diprediksi; warga yang melewati daerah tersebut mengatakan bahwa sebelumnya daerah itu tampak berbahaya.

Melihat foto jalan yang diambil sebelum kecelakaan, pepohonan tampak rapuh, karena telah berakar dan tumbuh di antara bebatuan yang curam.

◀ INT ▶ Warga di dekat lokasi kecelakaan longsoran batu

"Ketika terjadi pelapukan dan air mengalir masuk, karena batuan tersebut berlapis, maka akan menjadi kerikil yang hancur. Itu bukan batuan padat, tetapi keras. Sebelumnya, daerah itu berbahaya, dan bebatuan sering berguling ke bawah. Saya telah tinggal di sini selama 25 tahun."

Kota Daegu dan Kantor Nam-gu mengklaim bahwa lereng tempat kecelakaan terjadi tidak berada di bawah pengelolaan hukum.

Dalam kecelakaan di mana seorang pejalan kaki yang berjalan di trotoar tewas akibat longsoran batu tiba-tiba, penyebabnya harus diselidiki secara menyeluruh dan pihak yang bertanggung jawab harus dimintai pertanggungjawaban untuk mencegah terulangnya kejadian serupa.

Ini adalah Byeon Ye-ju dari MBC News.

(Liputan video oleh Yoon Jong-hee)

en-US.title: [R] Lives Lost to Rockfalls… Is It a Man-Made Disaster Due to Negligence? / Andong MBC
en-US.description:
2026/05/13 08:30:00 Author: Yang Gwan-hee

◀ Anchor ▶

Calls are being raised to identify the cause and hold accountable those responsible for the accident in which one person died after rocks and debris fell from the slope of an underpass near a park in Nam-gu, Daegu.

Attention is focused on the police investigation to see if administrative authorities can be held responsible.

Reporter Byeon Ye-ju reports.

◀ END ▶

◀ Report ▶

Experts and others are conducting an investigation at the site of the rockfall accident in Nam-gu, Daegu.

This is the location where a fatal accident occurred due to a rockfall on the 8th.

An expert who inspected the site revealed that after examining the bedrock, they confirmed jointing phenomena caused by the rock breaking, and that a tree had taken root in the crevices.

It is presumed that the rockfall accident occurred because strong winds on that day caused the tree to sway, widening the discontinuities in the bedrock.

At the time, strong winds with a maximum instantaneous speed of 16 meters per second were blowing in Daegu.

◀ INT ▶ Choi Jeong-hae / Professor, Department of Earth Science Education, Kyungpook National University
"It seems that the trees were shaking severely due to the strong winds, and as a result of that shaking, the joint surfaces that had been holding up until now loosened (causing the rockfall)."

Civil society groups and others are calling for a thorough investigation into the truth behind this fatal rockfall accident and for administrative authorities to be held accountable.

The police are investigating whether Daegu City and the Nam-gu Office are guilty of negligent homicide.

First and foremost, the key issue is whether this slope existed naturally or was artificially created.

It must be determined whether administrative authorities tampered with the slope while constructing the underpass and sidewalk, or if it is a natural slope located at the edge of the mountain.

It also needs to be examined whether the risk of an accident could have been foreseen; residents who pass through the area say it looked dangerous in the past.

Looking at photos of the road taken before the accident, the trees appear precarious, having taken root and grown between the steep rocks.

◀ INT ▶ Resident near the rockfall accident site

"When weathering occurs and water flows in, since it is layered rock, it becomes crumbling gravel. It's not solid rock, but hard. Before that, it was dangerous, and rocks used to roll down all the time. I've lived here for 25 years."

Daegu City and the Nam-gu Office claim that the slope where the accident occurred was not subject to legal management.

In an accident where a pedestrian walking on the sidewalk was killed by a sudden rockfall, the cause must be thoroughly investigated and those responsible held accountable to prevent recurrence.

This is Byeon Ye-ju from MBC News.

(Video coverage by Yoon Jong-hee)

snippet.title: R]울진 송전탑 공사장..주민 안전대책 마련 나서 / 안동MBC
snippet.description:
2026/05/13 08:30:00    작성자 : 김기영
 
◀ 앵 커 ▶
울진에 대규모 송전탑을 세우면서
마구잡이로 산을 깍아 산사태 우려가
있다는 소식, 지난주 전해드렸는데요.

행정안전부 등이 현장을 점검하고
유사시에 대비한 주민 안전대책 마련에
나섰습니다.

김기영 기자가 보도합니다.

◀ 리포트 ▶
행정안전부와 산림청, 경북도, 울진군이
합동으로 송전탑 건설 현장을 찾았습니다.

시공사 관계자는 대규모 토석류가 발생할
상황은 아니라고 설명했지만,
행안부는 장마철이 시작되기 전에
배수로 정비와 토사 유실 방지 등
응급대책을 마치라고 지시했습니다.

◀ INT ▶조수창 / 행정안전부 재난대응총괄과장
"적어도 우기 전에는 배수로를 정비한다든지, 또 토석류가 흘러가는 흐름을 끊을 수 있는 네트를 설치한다든지 이런 조치는 꼭 필요하다고 요청했습니다."

울진군은 유시시에 대비해 주민안전대책을
수립하기로 했습니다.

대피시설을 지정하고 주민대피 훈련을
실시하기로 했습니다.

◀ INT ▶구자희 / 울진군 부군수
"(어떤) 교통수단을 통해서 안전한 곳으로 이동시켜야 될지, 그리고 안전훈련을 어떻게 해야될지 그런 대책들을 지금 준비하고 있고요. 곧 시행할 계획입니다."

송전탑 아래에 있는 주민들은
자신들의 안전은 물론, 관광업도
타격을 받을 수 있는 중대한 사안이라며
관광객이 오지 않아 입게 될 2차 피해를
받지 않도록 대책을 서둘러 달라고
요구했습니다.

울진과 삼척의 발전소에서 신가평 변전소까지 500kV 송전탑 공사장에서 대규모 토석류
발생 우려가 크다는 환경단체의 문제 제기로, 산림청은 전국에서 진행중인 송전탑 사업지
682개소를 대상으로 현장점검에 나섰습니다.

허가구역 내·외 산림훼손 여부,
배수로 정비 상태, 사면 안정화 조치 여부,
현장 내 폐기물 방치 여부 등을
중점적으로 점검할 예정입니다.

MBC뉴스 김기영입니다.
◀ END ▶

id.title: [R] Lokasi Konstruksi Menara Transmisi Uljin... Warga Meningkatkan Langkah-Langkah Keamanan / And...
id.description:
13/05/2026 08:30:00 Penulis: Kim Ki-young

◀ Tajuk ▶
Kami melaporkan pekan lalu bahwa ada kekhawatiran tentang tanah longsor di Uljin karena penebangan gunung yang sembarangan saat membangun menara transmisi skala besar.

Kementerian Dalam Negeri dan Keamanan serta lembaga lainnya telah memeriksa lokasi tersebut dan sedang berupaya mempersiapkan langkah-langkah keselamatan bagi warga jika terjadi keadaan darurat.

Laporan oleh Kim Ki-young.

◀ Laporan ▶
Kementerian Dalam Negeri dan Keamanan, Dinas Kehutanan Korea, Provinsi Gyeongsang Utara, dan Kabupaten Uljin bersama-sama mengunjungi lokasi pembangunan menara transmisi.

Meskipun seorang pejabat dari perusahaan konstruksi menjelaskan bahwa situasi tersebut kemungkinan tidak akan menyebabkan aliran puing skala besar, Kementerian Dalam Negeri dan Keamanan memerintahkan agar langkah-langkah darurat, seperti pemeliharaan drainase dan pencegahan erosi tanah, diselesaikan sebelum musim hujan dimulai.

◀ INT ▶ Jo Su-chang / Kepala Divisi Tanggap Bencana, Kementerian Dalam Negeri dan Keamanan

"Kami meminta agar tindakan seperti pemeliharaan saluran drainase atau pemasangan jaring untuk memutus aliran puing-puing dilakukan setidaknya sebelum musim hujan."

Kabupaten Uljin telah memutuskan untuk menetapkan langkah-langkah keselamatan warga sebagai persiapan menghadapi potensi banjir.

Mereka telah memutuskan untuk menetapkan fasilitas evakuasi dan melakukan latihan evakuasi warga.

◀ INT ▶ Gu Ja-hee / Wakil Walikota Kabupaten Uljin

"Saat ini kami sedang mempersiapkan langkah-langkah mengenai cara mengangkut warga ke lokasi yang aman dan cara melakukan latihan keselamatan. Kami berencana untuk segera menerapkannya."

Warga yang tinggal di bawah menara transmisi menuntut agar langkah-langkah dipercepat untuk mencegah kerusakan sekunder yang disebabkan oleh kurangnya wisatawan, dengan menyatakan bahwa ini adalah masalah kritis yang dapat berdampak tidak hanya pada keselamatan mereka sendiri tetapi juga pada industri pariwisata. Menyusul kekhawatiran yang disampaikan oleh kelompok lingkungan mengenai risiko tinggi terjadinya aliran puing skala besar di lokasi pembangunan menara transmisi 500kV yang membentang dari pembangkit listrik di Uljin dan Samcheok hingga Gardu Induk Singapyeong, Dinas Kehutanan Korea telah meluncurkan inspeksi lapangan terhadap 682 proyek menara transmisi yang sedang berlangsung di seluruh negeri.

Inspeksi akan berfokus pada pemeriksaan kerusakan hutan di dalam dan di luar zona yang diizinkan, kondisi sistem drainase, langkah-langkah stabilisasi lereng, dan keberadaan sampah yang ditinggalkan di lokasi tersebut.

Ini Kim Ki-young dari MBC News.

◀ SELESAI ▶ #AndongMBC #AndongMBCNews #NewsDesk #NewsToday

en-US.title: Andong Mayor Kwon Ki-chang Summoned by Police Over People Power Party Nomination... Election Impa...
en-US.description:
May 13, 2026 08:30:00 Author: Lee Jung-hee

It has been reported that Andong Mayor Kwon Ki-chang, who was nominated as the People Power Party's candidate for Andong Mayor, was summoned to the Gyeongbuk Provincial Police Agency today (Wednesday, the 13th) for questioning.

It is understood that the investigation focused on whether there was any organized instruction or solicitation from Mayor Kwon regarding allegations of soliciting membership applications for the People Power Party involving executives of Andong City Hall and its affiliated organization, the Facilities Management Corporation.

The Gyeongbuk Provincial Police have been conducting an investigation targeting two senior Andong City officials and about 10 employees of the Facilities Management Corporation regarding the solicitation of party membership applications and allegations of Mayor Kwon receiving political funds.

As Mayor Kwon Ki-chang's various legal risks materialize, it is expected to have an impact on the landscape of the Andong mayoral election.

#AndongMBC #AndongMBCNews #NewsDesk #NewsToday

id.title: Wali Kota Andong, Kwon Ki-chang, Dipanggil Polisi Terkait Nominasi Partai Kekuatan Rakyat... Damp...
id.description:
13 Mei 2026 08:30:00 Penulis: Lee Jung-hee

Dilaporkan bahwa Walikota Andong Kwon Ki-chang, yang dinominasikan sebagai kandidat Partai Kekuatan Rakyat untuk Walikota Andong, dipanggil ke Kantor Polisi Provinsi Gyeongbuk hari ini (Rabu, 13 Mei) untuk dimintai keterangan.

Dipahami bahwa penyelidikan difokuskan pada apakah ada instruksi atau ajakan terorganisir dari Walikota Kwon terkait tuduhan meminta pendaftaran keanggotaan Partai Kekuatan Rakyat yang melibatkan para eksekutif Balai Kota Andong dan organisasi afiliasinya, Perusahaan Pengelola Fasilitas.

Kepolisian Provinsi Gyeongbuk telah melakukan penyelidikan yang menargetkan dua pejabat senior Kota Andong dan sekitar 10 karyawan Perusahaan Pengelola Fasilitas terkait permintaan pendaftaran keanggotaan partai dan tuduhan Walikota Kwon menerima dana politik.

Dengan munculnya berbagai risiko hukum yang dihadapi Walikota Kwon Ki-chang, diperkirakan akan berdampak pada lanskap pemilihan walikota Andong.

#AndongMBC #AndongMBCNews #NewsDesk #NewsToday

en-US.title: Andong and Yecheon Metropolitan and Local Council Candidates Depart from People Power Party and D...
en-US.description:
May 13, 2026 12:00:00 Author: Lee Jung-hee

Candidates for metropolitan and local council seats in the Andong and Yecheon regions, who were excluded from the People Power Party's nomination process, have declared their defection from the party and their intention to run as independents.

The candidates who took the stage at the press conference consisted of a total of five people: Kim Dae-il, the incumbent candidate for Andong holding four terms (combining metropolitan and local), three provincial council candidates (Kim Sang-jin of Andong and Lee Seung-hee of Yecheon), and two city council candidates (Kim Kyung-do and Kwon Ki-won of Andong).

They criticized the nomination process, stating that it was "a means for Representative Kim Hyung-dong to realize his personal desires and an outrage that deprived party members and residents of their right to choose."

The People Power Party has issued single nominations for 100% of the metropolitan and local council constituencies in Andong and Yecheon.

#AndongMBC #AndongMBCNews #NewsDesk #NewsToday

snippet.title: [ND:안동]주왕산 실종현장 가보니‥탐방로 벗어나자 바로 낭떠러지 / 안동MBC
snippet.description:
2026/05/13 08:30:00    작성자 : 김서현
 
◀ 앵 커 ▶
주왕산국립공원에서 실종됐다
숨진 채 발견된 초등학생에 대해
'추락에 의한 손상'이라는
1차 검시 소견이 나왔습니다.

취재진이 사고지점에 올라가 봤더니,
조금만 벗어나도 사고 우려가 큰
험준한 지역이었습니다.

김서현 기자가 취재했습니다.

◀ 리포트 ▶

실종된 초등학생이 방문한 대전사,

이곳에서 1시간 반 정도 올라가면
해발 720미터 주왕산 주봉 정상입니다.

초등학생이 올라갔을 거로 추정되는
탐방로로 올라가 봤습니다.

능선을 따라 난 좁은 산길 양 옆으로,
'탐방로 아님' 안내판이 연이어 나타납니다.

안전 울타리가 없는 구간도 많고,

탐방로를 조금만 벗어나면
낭떠러지에 가까운 가파른
협곡 지역이 나오는데

수풀에 가려 아래는 잘 보이지도 않습니다.

◀ INT ▶ 윤인수 / 청송군 주왕산면 주민
"사람이 다니는 그 길로 다니지, 딴 데로 갔다가는 엄청 낭떠러지고 막 험해. 깊은 골짜기에 잘못 들어가 버리면 이 방향감각을 잃어버려."

학생이 발견된 곳은 정상에서
400미터 밑 협곡 부근이었습니다.

◀ st-up ▶
"학생은 정규 탐방로를 벗어나
산비탈 아래에서 발견됐는데 보시다시피
경사가 그냥 걸어 내려갈 수 없을 정도로
급하고 수풀이 우거져 있습니다."

특히 수풀과 급경사가 이어져 길의 경계가
흐릿한 구간이었습니다.

◀ S Y N ▶ 김기창 / 국립공원공단 주왕산국립공원사무소 재난안전과장
"어두울 때나 아니면 본인의 실수에 의해서
실족을 한다고 그러면 해당 위치는 충분히
떨어지거나 추락할 수 있는 지점이긴 하고요."

숨진 학생은 산행 당시
휴대전화를 집에서
가져오지 않았던 것으로 파악됐는데,

경찰은 1차 검시에서
'추락에 의한 손상' 소견이 나왔다며
부검을 통해 정확한 사인을 확인할 방침입니다.

MBC뉴스 김서현입니다.
(영상취재 최재훈)
#안동MBC #안동MBC뉴스 #뉴스데스크 #뉴스투데이

id.title: [ND: Andong] Mengunjungi Lokasi Orang Hilang di Gunung Juwang... Tebing Tepat di Luar Jalur Penda...
id.description:
13/05/2026 08:30:00 Penulis: Kim Seo-hyun

◀ Pembawa Acara ▶

Mengenai siswa sekolah dasar yang hilang di Taman Nasional Juwangsan dan kemudian ditemukan meninggal,

laporan otopsi pendahuluan menyimpulkan bahwa penyebab kematian adalah "cedera akibat jatuh."

Ketika tim peliputan kami pergi ke lokasi kecelakaan, kami menemukan bahwa itu adalah daerah terjal di mana bahkan sedikit penyimpangan pun menimbulkan risiko kecelakaan yang tinggi.

Reporter Kim Seo-hyun meliput berita ini.

◀ Laporan ▶

Kuil Daejeonsa, yang dikunjungi oleh siswa sekolah dasar yang hilang tersebut.

Jika Anda mendaki dari sini selama sekitar satu setengah jam,

Anda akan mencapai puncak utama Gunung Juwangsan,

pada ketinggian 720 meter.

Kami mendaki jalur pendakian
di mana siswa tersebut diduga pergi.

Di sepanjang jalan setapak sempit di pegunungan yang membentang di sepanjang punggung bukit,

tanda "Bukan Jalur Pendakian" muncul satu demi satu.

Ada banyak bagian tanpa pagar pengaman,

dan jika Anda sedikit saja menyimpang dari jalur, Anda akan menemukan area ngarai curam yang dekat dengan tebing terjal,

dan pemandangan di bawahnya hampir tidak terlihat karena terhalang semak-semak.

◀ INT ▶ Yoon In-soo / Warga Juwangsan-myeon, Cheongsong-gun

"Kami tetap berada di jalur yang biasa dilalui orang; jika Anda pergi ke tempat lain, ada tebing besar dan medannya sangat sulit. Jika Anda tanpa sengaja tersesat ke lembah yang dalam, Anda akan kehilangan arah."

Siswa tersebut ditemukan di dekat ngarai,

400 meter di bawah puncak.

◀ st-up ▶

"Siswa tersebut menyimpang dari jalur biasa dan ditemukan di dasar lereng gunung. Seperti yang Anda lihat,

lerengnya sangat curam sehingga Anda tidak bisa begitu saja menuruni lereng tersebut, dan semak-semaknya tumbuh lebat."

Secara khusus, bagian tersebut memiliki batas jalur yang kabur karena semak belukar yang lebat dan lereng yang curam.

◀ S Y N ▶ Kim Ki-chang / Kepala Divisi Keselamatan Bencana, Kantor Taman Nasional Juwangsan, Dinas Taman Nasional Korea

"Jika gelap atau jika seseorang terpeleset karena kesalahan sendiri, lokasi yang dimaksud memang merupakan tempat di mana seseorang dapat jatuh atau terjatuh dengan cukup berbahaya."

Telah dipastikan bahwa siswa yang meninggal tersebut tidak membawa telepon seluler dari rumah selama pendakian.

Polisi menyatakan bahwa pemeriksaan awal menunjukkan "cedera akibat jatuh," dan mereka berencana untuk memastikan penyebab pasti kematian melalui otopsi.

Ini adalah Kim Seo-hyun dari MBC News.

(Liputan video oleh Choi Jae-hoon)

en-US.title: [ND: Andong] Visiting the Scene of the Missing Person at Mt. Juwang... A Cliff Immediately Off th...
en-US.description:
2026/05/13 08:30:00 Author: Kim Seo-hyun

◀ Anchor ▶

Regarding the elementary school student who went missing in Juwangsan National Park and was later found dead,

a preliminary autopsy report has concluded that the cause of death was "injuries caused by a fall."

When our reporting team went up to the accident site, we found it to be a rugged area where even a slight deviation poses a high risk of accidents.

Reporter Kim Seo-hyun covered the story.

◀ Report ▶

Daejeonsa Temple, which the missing elementary school student visited.

If you climb up from here for about an hour and a half,

you reach the summit of the main peak of Juwangsan Mountain,

at an elevation of 720 meters.

We went up the hiking trail
where the student is presumed to have gone.

Along the narrow mountain path running along the ridge,

"Not a Hiking Trail" signs appear one after another.

There are many sections without safety fences,

and if you stray even slightly from the trail, you encounter steep canyon areas that are close to sheer cliffs,

and the view below is barely visible as it is obscured by bushes.

◀ INT ▶ Yoon In-soo / Resident of Juwangsan-myeon, Cheongsong-gun

"We stick to the paths people use; if you go anywhere else, there are huge cliffs and it gets really rough. If you accidentally wander into a deep valley, you lose your sense of direction."

The student was found near a canyon,

400 meters below the summit.

◀ st-up ▶

"The student strayed from the regular trail and was found at the bottom of the mountain slope. As you can see,

the slope is so steep that you cannot simply walk down it, and the bushes are overgrown."

In particular, it was a section where the boundaries of the path were blurred due to the continuous bushes and steep slopes.

◀ S Y N ▶ Kim Ki-chang / Head of Disaster Safety Division, Juwangsan National Park Office, Korea National Park Service

"If it is dark or if someone slips due to their own mistake, the location in question is indeed a spot where one could sufficiently fall or plummet."

It has been determined that the deceased student did not bring their mobile phone from home during the hike.

The police stated that the initial examination indicated "injury caused by a fall," and they plan to confirm the exact cause of death through an autopsy.

This is Kim Seo-hyun from MBC News.

(Video coverage by Choi Jae-hoon)

ko.title: [ND:안동]주왕산 실종현장 가보니‥탐방로 벗어나자 바로 낭떠러지 / 안동MBC
ko.description:
2026/05/13 08:30:00    작성자 : 김서현
 
◀ 앵 커 ▶
주왕산국립공원에서 실종됐다
숨진 채 발견된 초등학생에 대해
'추락에 의한 손상'이라는
1차 검시 소견이 나왔습니다.

취재진이 사고지점에 올라가 봤더니,
조금만 벗어나도 사고 우려가 큰
험준한 지역이었습니다.

김서현 기자가 취재했습니다.

◀ 리포트 ▶

실종된 초등학생이 방문한 대전사,

이곳에서 1시간 반 정도 올라가면
해발 720미터 주왕산 주봉 정상입니다.

초등학생이 올라갔을 거로 추정되는
탐방로로 올라가 봤습니다.

능선을 따라 난 좁은 산길 양 옆으로,
'탐방로 아님' 안내판이 연이어 나타납니다.

안전 울타리가 없는 구간도 많고,

탐방로를 조금만 벗어나면
낭떠러지에 가까운 가파른
협곡 지역이 나오는데

수풀에 가려 아래는 잘 보이지도 않습니다.

◀ INT ▶ 윤인수 / 청송군 주왕산면 주민
"사람이 다니는 그 길로 다니지, 딴 데로 갔다가는 엄청 낭떠러지고 막 험해. 깊은 골짜기에 잘못 들어가 버리면 이 방향감각을 잃어버려."

학생이 발견된 곳은 정상에서
400미터 밑 협곡 부근이었습니다.

◀ st-up ▶
"학생은 정규 탐방로를 벗어나
산비탈 아래에서 발견됐는데 보시다시피
경사가 그냥 걸어 내려갈 수 없을 정도로
급하고 수풀이 우거져 있습니다."

특히 수풀과 급경사가 이어져 길의 경계가
흐릿한 구간이었습니다.

◀ S Y N ▶ 김기창 / 국립공원공단 주왕산국립공원사무소 재난안전과장
"어두울 때나 아니면 본인의 실수에 의해서
실족을 한다고 그러면 해당 위치는 충분히
떨어지거나 추락할 수 있는 지점이긴 하고요."

숨진 학생은 산행 당시
휴대전화를 집에서
가져오지 않았던 것으로 파악됐는데,

경찰은 1차 검시에서
'추락에 의한 손상' 소견이 나왔다며
부검을 통해 정확한 사인을 확인할 방침입니다.

MBC뉴스 김서현입니다.
